## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Changed behaviour has its page in `docs/` changed too
- [ ] New setting is in `.env.example` and `docs/settings.md`
- [ ] New tool is in `docs/tools.md`, with honest annotations
- [ ] Plain words, and no em dashes
- [ ] No real data, keys, names or private details anywhere in the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line
- [ ] The credit (`NOTICE`, `CITATION.cff`) is unchanged
- [ ] No safety rule in `AGENTS.md` is weakened
